description: This file defines the FilesystemLoader class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for loading templates from the filesystem, managing template paths, and handling template cache and errors.

classes.name: FilesystemLoader
classes.description: A class that loads Twig templates from the filesystem, supporting multiple paths and namespaces, with cache management and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the loader with given paths and optional root path.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of template paths for a given namespace.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets multiple paths for a namespace.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new path to a namespace, validating its existence.

methods.name: prependPath
methods.description: Prepends a new path to a namespace, validating its existence.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source content of a template by name.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a template based on its path.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is up-to-date based on modification time.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Locates the template file path, with optional error throwing.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes template name by replacing backslashes and multiple slashes.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses a namespaced template name into namespace and shortname.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates template name for security and correctness.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Determines if a path is absolute.
